module: Interactive Lua console (REPL) for the console executable (console.x64.exe): require('utils/interactiveShell').start() reads lines from standard input and executes them. Used for development and testing outside the UI; a modder does not normally use it in the normal game. Also defines helper globals.
notes: Defines the GLOBALS spawnObjects (alias sp), updateOnce, updateLoop (alias ul).
Special commands in the shell: help, tracktime (times each command), unittests / ut, reload (reloadLua()), testenv, exit/quit/Ctrl-D (character 4).
spawnObjects deletes ALL objects (BeamEngine:deleteAllObjects()) before recreating n objects 'vehicles/<v>' (pickup by default), spaced in y by 3*n. It warns if the number of slots does not match.
updateOnce and updateLoop call BeamEngine:update(1/2000, 1/2000); updateOnce ignores its parameter n; updateLoop runs n+1 iterations (loop from 0 to n).
The 'unittests' command references lua/tests/unittests, which may not exist in the shipped version (inferred from code).

start.desc: Blocking loop: shows the '> ' prompt, reads a line, handles the shortcuts then executes the line with loadstring/xpcall and prints the result or the error with trace. Exits on end of input, 'exit', 'quit' or Ctrl-D. Calls updateLuaCore() each iteration if it exists (cleanup and GC).

spawnObjects.desc: Helper GLOBAL (alias sp): deletes all objects then spawns n vehicles.

v.desc: Name of the vehicle folder under 'vehicles/', 'pickup' by default

updateOnce.desc: Helper GLOBAL: one update of the simulation engine (BeamEngine:update(1/2000, 1/2000)).

updateLoop.desc: Helper GLOBAL (alias ul): n+1 updates of the simulation engine at 1/2000 s.
